text:
```yaml
name: Generate Documentation

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]

jobs:
  generate-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '20.x'
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install
    
    - name: Generate API documentation
      run: |
        npx jsdoc-to-markdown src/**/*.js > API.md
        echo "# API Documentation" > temp-api.md
        cat API.md >> temp-api.md
        mv temp-api.md API.md
    
    - name: Update README with API reference
      run: |
        echo "" >> README.md
        echo "## API Reference" >> README.md
        echo "" >> README.md
        echo "[View full API documentation](API.md)" >> README.md
    
    - name: Commit changes
      run: |
        git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
        git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
        git add API.md README.md
        git commit -m "Update API documentation" || echo "No changes to commit"
    
    - name: Push changes
      uses: ad-m/github-push-action@master
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        branch: ${{ github.ref }}
```
